page.layout: One block: centred title page, every line set in the centre of the page, with a woodcut vignette and the imprint below. No columns, no margin notes.

main_text.l: Hoc potissimum consilio seorsim excusa, ut liber

page.notes: The woodcut vignette shows an oval wreath around a tree being cut, with a ribbon reading "BENIGNITATE" / "AC SEVERITATE" and "VIDE" (partly illegible). Not transcribed as text. The title line "CATECHETICIS" and "Opera extrema" are in italic type in the original; "Hoc potissimum ... ut liber" is italic. Minor italic lines are shown here without markup because the page is a title page with only <l> lines. The "Æ" in GENEVÆ is printed as a ligature. The date line is printed with a macron-like mark over the final V, and "DAVIDIS PAREI" shows a pilcrow-like mark between PA and REI that may be a printing blemish. Possible illegibility at the ribbon text.
